title: Make a bug report useful
summary: A bug report should let another person repeat the problem. Include steps, expected behaviour and actual behaviour.
introduction: A bug report should let another person repeat the problem. Include steps, expected behaviour and actual behaviour. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain make a bug report useful
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A bug report should let another person repeat the problem. Include steps, expected behaviour and actual behaviour.

blocks.code:
Steps: open quiz, answer 2 questions, press Next
Expected: question 3 appears
Actual: question 2 stays visible
Browser: the browser used for the test
blocks.title: Make a bug report useful

blocks.text: These details give someone a clear starting point. Personal details are not needed.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a report for a button that does nothing.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A report that only says broken does not explain how to reproduce the issue.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
